# AurelianAegis

> Open attestation specification for governed enterprise AI agent operations.

AurelianAegis defines an open, domain-agnostic attestation envelope for recording pre-execution policy authorization and post-execution runtime outcomes as signed, integrity-verifiable evidence.

## Primary Resources

- Homepage: https://aurelianaegis.io/
- JSON Schema: https://github.com/aurelian-aegis/aurelianaegis-attestation-schema/blob/main/schema/releases/v1.0.0/attestation-envelope.json
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/aurelian-aegis/aurelianaegis-attestation-schema

## What This Site Covers

- AI agent governance attestation model
- Admissibility token (pre-execution authorization record)
- Execution receipt (post-execution outcome record)
- Signature verification and canonicalization expectations
- Enterprise SIEM and GRC integration patterns

## Intended Audience

Platform engineering, security, governance, risk, compliance, and audit teams implementing governed AI operations.

## Policy

Public documentation and specification content may be indexed and summarized by AI assistants and search systems.
